trace.instruction: Open Aquariums.
Close this window to view the aquarium and its current readings.

target.html: <button id="primary-close" aria-label="Close window" class="tutorial-target">×</button>

trace.instruction: Click Prepare your aquarium to review Tank Setup. A dry aquarium needs sand, saltwater and life support before fish.

target.html: <button class="primary tutorial-target" id="onboard-action">Prepare your aquarium →</button>

trace.instruction: Choose Aquarium Store in this window selector.

target.text: AquariumsAquarium StoreField JournalTank CareThe Dock CasinoSettings

trace.instruction: Open Sand & Substrate.

target.html: <button data-store-action="category" data-store-args="{"id":"sand"}" class="tutorial-target">Sand & Substrate</button>

trace.instruction: Select sand in Aquarium Store, set its depth and confirm the real purchase. Sand installs directly into the selected aquarium.

target.html: <button data-store-action="details" data-store-args="{"id":"sand:fiji"}" class="tutorial-target">View Details</button>

trace.instruction: Set a positive sand depth. The selected depth changes the actual sandbed; sand-dependent species may require more.

target.html: <input name="depth" type="number" min="0" max="5" step="0.1" value="0" required="" class="tutorial-target">

trace.instruction: Review the price and destination, then confirm to install the chosen sand depth.

target.html: <button class="primary tutorial-target" id="confirm-fish" type="submit">Confirm purchase</button>

trace.instruction: Close Aquarium Store, then open Aquariums.

target.html: <button id="store-close" aria-label="Close aquarium store" class="tutorial-target">×</button>

trace.instruction: Open Aquariums.
Use Add water in Tank Setup. Filling and preparing saltwater are separate from biological cycling.

target.html: <button class="tutorial-target" data-action="fillWater" data-args="{}">Add water</button>

trace.instruction: Use Prepare water in Tank Setup. This records actual preparation; it does not establish the nitrogen cycle.

target.html: <button class="primary tutorial-target" data-action="prepare" data-args="{}">Prepare water</button>

trace.instruction: Open Aquariums.
Start fishless cycling in Tank Setup. Bacteria process ammonia into nitrite and then nitrate. Wait for the real simulation; normal speed controls remain available.

target.html: <button class="primary tutorial-target" data-action="cycle" data-args="{}">Start fishless cycle</button>

Open Fish.

trace.instruction: Read Onyx Percula (350 AC). This listing fits the actual tank and supported care profile.
